uzo.purpose: Names a status in one to three words next to what it describes: draft, in review, valid, 3 violations; an icon before the words (slot icon-start) shows it beyond colour.

instead.kialo: A badge is read in passing, because a status is one glance; a sentence that explains is a notice (avizo).
A badge is no control, because a label that answers a click hides an action; an action is a butono, a destination a ligilo.
A bare number says nothing, because '3' without 'violations' is no status; a person decides what the number is.
A value in a range is a measure, not a status, because it has a scale; that is the mezurilo.
Who something belongs to is a person, because a face or the initials say who; that is the avataro, and the badge says how.

boundary.kialo: A badge in the brand colour says no status, because the brand colour is no state; a person decides what it marks.
A dot without text is colour alone, because a person who does not see the hue reads nothing (WCAG 1.4.1); the text is required.
A chip that can be removed is a filter, because removing acts; the signeto covers it (Spec 025 ③ closes the boundary removable-chip).

containers.name: tabelo
containers.kialo: A status stands in the cell of its row, because the row is what it describes (tabelo, ④).

containers.name: atributlisto
containers.kialo: A status is the value of an attribute, because the key names what it says (atributlisto, ④).

containers.name: page-title
containers.kialo: A status stands next to the title of what it describes, because that is where a person looks first.

containers.name: navigado
containers.kialo: A count next to a navigation entry says how much waits there, because the entry is what it counts (navigado, ⑤).

with.kialo: An icon per intent may stand beside the word as an ikono, never alone, because the word is the status and the sign only strengthens it (G6).

case.de: Der Zustand braucht einen ganzen Satz, der erklärt.
case.en: The state needs a whole sentence that explains.

case.de: Das Etikett soll sich wählen oder entfernen lassen.
case.en: The tag is to be chosen or removed.

case.de: Ein Klick auf das Etikett soll etwas auslösen.
case.en: A click on the badge is to start something.

case.de: Ein Wert liegt in einem Bereich mit Skala.
case.en: A value lies in a range with a scale.

do.de: Sag den Zustand in ein bis drei Wörtern.
do.en: Say the state in one to three words.

do.de: Nimm intent neutral für eine bloße Tatsache wie Entwurf.
do.en: Use intent neutral for a plain fact such as draft.

do.de: Setz ein Symbol vor die Wörter, wenn der Zustand mehr als Farbe zeigen soll.
do.en: Put an icon before the words when the state should show more than colour.

dont.de: Nur einen Punkt oder nur eine Zahl ohne Wort zeigen.
dont.en: Show only a dot or only a number without a word.

dont.de: Die Markenfarbe als Zustand nehmen, denn sie sagt keinen.
dont.en: Use the brand colour as a state, because it says none.

none.de: Das Etikett nimmt weder den Fokus noch eine Taste; es wird mit dem Text gelesen, neben dem es steht.
none.en: The badge takes neither the focus nor a key; it is read with the text it stands beside.
